name: Tabs
description: Tablist navigation with keyboard support, a sliding selection indicator, and per-item icon/count.

a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-05-26 — arrow-key navigation and selection verified in Storybook. 2026-07-08 — promoted after ContactInquiryPanel adopted Tabs for the production contact message/book switcher; check:beta-promotion-readiness verifies production consumers, snapshots, forced colors, and real Figma evidence.

activeTab.description: Active tab key (controlled mode); "" is treated as absent.

tabs.description: Array of tab items with key, label, optional disabled/icon/count.

onTabChange.description: Called with the clicked tab's key.

className.description: Optional utility classes on the tablist.

forbiddenUse: nest tablists inside another tablist. APG explicitly disallows
use Tabs for non-mutually-exclusive content. Two panels open
dense: Tablist-only tabs (panels via getTabPanelProps); variant default|pills|underline + sliding indicator; per-item icon+count; size sm|md|lg; controlled/uncontrolled; roving arrow-key focus

usage.description: Tabs renders the tablist only — the parent owns the panels, pairing each to its tab with the exported `getTabPanelProps(key, isActive)` helper (or matching id/aria-labelledby/hidden attributes by hand). Drive it controlled with `activeTab` + `onTabChange`, or uncontrolled with `defaultActiveTab`. Arrow keys move a roving focus through enabled tabs; `variant` picks the visual language (default, pills, underline) and `size` the density. Tabs switch views in place — they are not page navigation.

bestPractices.description: Render one tabpanel per tab and wire it with getTabPanelProps so aria-controls/aria-labelledby stay consistent.
Use controlled mode (activeTab + onTabChange) when the active tab should sync with URL or app state.
Keep tab labels to one or two words; tabs are a switch, not a table of contents.
Disable a tab with disabled on its item instead of removing it, so the set stays stable while unavailable.
Do not use tabs for page navigation — that is NavLink in a nav landmark; tabs switch views inside one page.
Do not lazy-delete panel DOM for inactive tabs that hold form state; hide them (hidden attr) so user input survives switching.

anatomy.name: Tablist
anatomy.description: role=tablist container owning roving arrow-key focus across enabled tabs.

anatomy.name: Tab
anatomy.description: role=tab button with aria-selected and aria-controls pointing at its panel id; may carry an optional leading icon and trailing count pill.

anatomy.name: Indicator
anatomy.description: Single aria-hidden element per tablist that slides to the selected tab (2px rail bar for underline, raised thumb for pills, filled segment for default).

anatomy.name: Tabpanel
anatomy.description: Parent-rendered region paired via getTabPanelProps: id, aria-labelledby, hidden when inactive.
